videos.title: Dermalogica Stressed Skin Recovery System (2 Full-Size): What It Does and How to Use It
videos.lead: Dermalogica stressed skin recovery system (2 full-size): Multivitamin Power Recovery Cream, from the Westville body care desk.
facts: What's inside: multivitamin power recovery cream (50ml); multivitamin power recovery masque (75ml)
Recovery cream boosts skin resilience to prevent premature signs of skin aging; recovery masque is a restorative masque for skin exposed to stress
Repairs daily damage triggered by free radicals
Fights environmental stressors with powerful multivitamins

How to use: Cream: after cleansing and toning, apply over face and neck with light, upward strokes, morning and night. Masque: apply generously to cleansed face and throat, avoiding the eye area; after 10 to 15 minutes rinse with warm water; once per week or whenever skin requires a soothing remedy.

videos.title: Label Read: Dermalogica Get + Keep Your Glow Kit (2 Full-Size) #shorts
videos.lead: Dermalogica get + keep your glow kit (2 full-size): brightens and combats skin aging, from the Bedfordview labels and ingredients desk.
facts: What's inside: BioLumin-C Serum (30ml); Dynamic Skin Recovery SPF 50 (50ml)
Provides long-lasting hydration and critical protection against UV light
Helps control the triggers that lead to skin aging

How to use: Dispense a full dropper of BioLumin-C Serum and smooth over cleansed face and neck, after toning and before moisturizing. Follow with Dynamic Skin Recovery SPF50 and apply a generous amount to face and neck, preferably 30 minutes prior to sun exposure.
